data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic word 'basharah', which means 'good news' or 'joyful'. It is a beautiful name for a baby boy, evoking feelings of happiness and calmness. The name Bashash carries the meaning “Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bashash usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Bashash belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bashash total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Another historical reference to the name Bashash is found in the context of the 13th century Mongol invasion of the Islamic world. The name Bashash is mentioned in the memoirs of the Mongol general Subutai, who led the Mongol army to defeat the Islamic forces at the Battle of Ain Jalut in 1260. Bashash is described as being a Muslim leader who fought against the Mongols and was killed in the battle.
